The deadline in WileyPLUS is authoritative; Canvas's Due and Until fields
are intentionally blank.

## Submission and grading

Launch [Assignment 5 in Canvas]({{< meta canvas.assignment_5 >}}) and complete
it **individually** in WileyPLUS. Follow the
[course assignment ground rules](../pages/assignments.qmd#individual-assignments).

- The assignment is automatically graded, with **three attempts per question**,
  **no score reduction**, and the **best score** retained.
- WileyPLUS randomizes values for each student while keeping that student's
  values fixed across attempts.
- Answer feedback is available as answers are submitted. Textbook resources
  are always available; hints become available after the first attempt, and
  correct answers and solutions after the last attempt. Assistance carries
  no score deduction.
- Work is automatically submitted to the Canvas gradebook on the due date.
  WileyPLUS notes that auto-submission uses one attempt and may take up to
  ten minutes. Submit your answers before the deadline.
- Late submissions are not enabled. Assignment review becomes available
  after the deadline.
